facebook.caption: This place fixes burnout. Chen Sea Resort & Spa sits on Bãi Xếp, Ông Lang, away from the crowds. Minimalist villas. Private beach. Infinity pool that drops straight into the treeline. 4.5 stars across 890 reviews. Open-air gym if you actually want to move. Dining on-site so you never have to leave. Some trips are about seeing things. This one is about stopping. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
